name: 金庸群侠传（2015版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2015 Edition)
english_description: The 2015 release of this project's 金庸群侠传/"Jin Yong Heroes Gathering" (ES II engine) family -- confirmed via md5sum an even closer engine match to sibling jqxz2008 than jqxz2008's own match to xiakexing3 (master, security, login, and Chinese-text daemon files are byte-identical or differ by a single blank line), but a genuine seven-years-later content fork: net +187/-67 files, including a new zone (honghua) and an expanded Beggars'-Sect obj set (city2's imperial-palace district itself is not actually new here -- file-count-verified present in all four 2008/2015 editions alike) and drift in both directions (a file corrupted in jqxz2008 is complete here; a different file is truncated here but fine in the 2008 builds). This is the only edition in the family taken through a full unassisted combat-to-death cycle: a test character picked a fight with 萧峰 (Qiao Feng), a named high-power NPC on the main street, was genuinely killed, and went through corpse, ghost-gate dialogue, and reincarnation for real, plus a live-triggered sect-defection from Feng Qingyang's tutelage and a completed shop purchase. Deep testing found and fixed this family's usual severe bugs (corrupted-save Chinese-text crash, missing-directory death crash, wrong-object food/water check) plus a bug unique to this build: an uninitialized skills mapping crashed for ANY freshly-registered, still-untrained character who merely walked past 萧峰 on the main street, found in 5 separate NPC files -- see NOTES.md.
